subject: Ciências Humanas e Sociais Aplicadas
description_pt: Identificar, analisar e comparar diferentes fontes e narrativas expressas em diversas linguagens, com vistas à compreensão de ideias filosóficas e de processos e eventos históricos, geográficos, políticos, econômicos, sociais, ambientais e culturais.

components.description_pt: Identificar diferentes fontes e narrativas expressas em formas diversas de linguagem relevantes às ciências humanas e sociais
components.description_en: Identify different sources and narratives expressed in diverse forms of language relevant to human and social sciences
components.cc_component_description: Integrate information from multiple sources presented in diverse media formats

components.description_pt: Analisar ideias filosóficas, eventos históricos e processos sociais, geográficos ou políticos usando fontes primárias e secundárias
components.description_en: Analyze philosophical ideas, historical events, and social, geographic, or political processes using primary and secondary sources
components.cc_component_description: Integrate information from multiple primary and secondary sources into a coherent understanding

components.description_pt: Analisar similaridades e diferenças em como fontes primárias e secundárias apresentam o mesmo evento ou tema
components.description_en: Analyze similarities and differences in how primary and secondary sources present the same event or topic
components.cc_component_description: Analyze similarities and differences in how primary and secondary sources present the same event or topic

components.description_pt: Avaliar a perspectiva, contexto e confiabilidade de fontes usadas para interpretar conteúdos de ciências humanas e sociais
components.description_en: Evaluate the perspective, context, and reliability of sources used to interpret human and social sciences content
components.cc_component_description: Identify and evaluate the credibility of sources used to support a claim

cc_matches.description: Analyze the relationship between a primary and secondary source on the same topic.
Integrate multiple sources of information presented in diverse media or formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively, orally) evaluating the credibility and accuracy of each source.
Integrate information from diverse sources, both primary and secondary, into a coherent understanding of an idea or event, noting discrepancies among sources.
Support claim(s) with logical reasoning and relevant evidence, using accurate, credible sources and demonstrating an understanding of the topic or text.
